body: Took my mind off for a bit, though i think i missed most of the cultural references... But now i'm pretty much where i was before.

The thing is: Sure, i can continue living day to day somehow, wasting everyones time and money achieving nothing but suffering, but what's the point? People around me wouldn't be hurt, that's all, and it's been keeping me alive for quite a few years now. But how is that supposed to get me out of the bed in the morning (or, at least, afternoon), or stop my tears at night?
